title: Awrad goal presets v1
description: Built-in shortcuts for creating goals (seasons and occasions). A preset fills in a goal's schedule, and sometimes its requirement; the rules never read the key. See README.md.

key.description: Stable catalog key (ADR-2026-07-13). Display names live in each platform's localization resources as goal_preset_<key>.

requirement.description: null: the user picks the requirement.
